title: Product Delivery Lead - The Semios Group - Application

fields.question: Summary
fields.name: summary
fields.value: Senior Site Reliability Engineer with 8 years running Kubernetes on AWS at scale. I ran 400 microservices on Kubernetes (AWS EKS) and cut incident time by 40 percent with Datadog and OpenTelemetry. I also built the Terraform platform used by 120 engineers.

fields.question: What are your salary expectations for this role? A range is fine.

fields.question: Describe a time you improved backlog cleanliness and Jira structure across multiple teams without adding unnecessary process overhead.
fields.name: QA_12543006
fields.value: • Add: the size of the teams and the backlog you worked across, and what you changed in Jira (workflow, fields or cleanup rules). • Add: the result, such as a measurable drop in stale tickets or faster planning. • Add: how you kept the process light, for example by avoiding new meetings or approval steps.
